summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of LineSight QA anomaly detection app. All backend APIs (17/17) and frontend user flows (12/12) passed successfully. Real Gemini vision integration working perfectly with accurate defect detection.

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about chart width/height (-1) when rendering with limited data
design_issues.impact: No visual or functional impact, charts render correctly

design_issues.issue: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent
design_issues.impact: Accessibility warning only, dialog functions correctly

passed_tests: Backend: Root API endpoint returns correct model info (gemini-3.1-pro-preview)
Backend: GET /api/samples returns 3 good and 5 defect demo images
Backend: GET /api/overview returns fleet statistics
Backend: POST /api/product-lines creates new line successfully
Backend: GET /api/product-lines lists all lines
Backend: GET /api/product-lines/{id} retrieves specific line
Backend: POST /api/product-lines/{id}/calibrate builds baseline via Gemini (real API call, ~15s)
Backend: POST /api/product-lines/{id}/inspect detects scratch defect as FAIL with 0.99 confidence and 1 region
Backend: POST /api/product-lines/{id}/inspect detects good part as PASS with 0.98 confidence and 0 regions
Backend: GET /api/product-lines/{id}/inspections lists inspection history
Backend: GET /api/product-lines/{id}/inspections?verdict=FAIL filters by verdict
Backend: GET /api/inspections/{id} returns full inspection with line_name
Backend: GET /api/product-lines/{id}/dashboard returns stats, pass_rate, trend, defect_distribution, drift
Backend: GET /api/product-lines/{id}/insights returns clusters, location_distribution, hints
Backend: DELETE /api/inspections/{id} removes inspection
Backend: DELETE /api/product-lines/{id} removes line and all inspections
Backend: Overview after cleanup shows 0 lines and 0 inspections
Frontend: Dashboard loads with KPIs (lines, inspections, pass rate, failures)
Frontend: Dashboard shows empty state when no lines exist
Frontend: Navigation to Product Lines page via 'Manage Lines' button
Frontend: Create product line dialog opens with name and description inputs
Frontend: Product line creation succeeds and navigates to line detail page
Frontend: Line detail page shows calibration tab with 'Use demo sample parts' button
Frontend: Calibration with demo samples completes successfully (Gemini API ~15s)
Frontend: Baseline status shows 'Calibrated v1' badge after calibration
Frontend: Inspect tab loads with demo defect thumbnails (scratch, missing_bolt, dent, corrosion, good)
Frontend: Inspection with scratch defect returns FAIL verdict with bounding box annotation
Frontend: Inspection with good part returns PASS verdict with no regions
Frontend: Inspection result card displays verdict badge, confidence, and annotated image
Frontend: Full inspection report opens with verdict header, confidence gauge, regions table
Frontend: History tab lists 2 inspections with verdict badges and thumbnails
Frontend: History verdict filter works (ALL, PASS, FAIL, UNCERTAIN)
Frontend: Insights tab shows KPIs (pass rate 50%, fail rate 50%, avg confidence 98.5%)
Frontend: Insights tab displays drift assessment card
Frontend: Insights tab shows root-cause hints
Frontend: Insights tab renders defect type distribution chart
Frontend: Insights tab renders confidence & anomaly trend chart
Frontend: Insights tab shows defect location heat grid (3x3)
Frontend: Theme toggle switches between light and dark mode
Frontend: Navigation back to lines list shows created line with calibrated badge

additional_notes.gemini_integration: Real Gemini vision API (gemini-3.1-pro-preview) working perfectly. Calibration and inspection calls complete in 10-30 seconds as expected.
additional_notes.defect_detection_accuracy: Scratch defect correctly detected as FAIL with 0.99 confidence and accurate bounding box localization. Good part correctly detected as PASS with 0.98 confidence.
additional_notes.bounding_box_annotations: Normalized bounding boxes [x,y,w,h] 0-1 correctly rendered on canvas with red rectangles.
additional_notes.demo_samples: Built-in demo sample system working perfectly - no need for file uploads during testing.
additional_notes.dashboard_insights: Dashboard shows accurate statistics, drift detection, defect clustering, and root-cause hints.
additional_notes.ui_polish: Clean, professional UI with proper empty states, loading indicators, toast notifications, and theme support.
additional_notes.performance: All API calls respond quickly except Gemini vision calls which take expected 10-30s.
additional_notes.data_persistence: MongoDB persistence working correctly - inspections saved and retrievable.
